mil7.8.5:1.1: Bhante Nāgasena, agadassa dve angāni gahetabbānīti yaṃ vadesi, katamāni tāni dve angāni gahetabbānīti.
mil7.8.5:1.2: Yathā mahārāja agade kimī na saṇṭhahanti,
mil7.8.5:1.3: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena mānase kilesā na saṇṭhapetabbā.
mil7.8.5:1.4: Idaṃ mahārāja agadassa paṭhamaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.8.5:2.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja agado daṭṭhaphuṭṭha-diṭṭha-asita-pīta-khāyita-sāyitaṃ sabbaṃ visaṃ paṭihanti,
mil7.8.5:2.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena rāga-dosa-moha-māna-diṭṭhi-visaṃ sabbaṃ paṭihanitabbaṃ.
mil7.8.5:2.3: Idaṃ mahārāja agadassa dutiyaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
